changelog: Unified 1-click update system: removed separate Sync Daemon option. One single click now updates both the app and internal daemon seamlessly.
Fixed Pure Monochrome theme contrast on Dark Mode: resolved white-on-white text in buttons, dialogs, and chips with dynamic on_primary mapping.
Added 10-second resilience network retry: when internet drops, displays a 10s live countdown reconnection card instead of immediately throwing an error.
Seamless auto-resume: automatically continues AI task generation without user intervention as soon as internet connection returns within the 10-second window.
